# pipecat-unison

> Drop-in persistent memory for [Pipecat](https://pipecat.ai) voice AI agents, powered
> by the [Unison brain](https://unisonlabs.ai) — a hosted, path-addressable knowledge
> base with hybrid semantic + keyword search.

**Agents: start with [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)** — it covers install, auth with a `usk_`
key, programmatic usage, and how to contribute to this repo.

The Pipecat processor (`backend/unison_pipecat.py`) intercepts `LLMContextFrame`
objects in your pipeline, retrieves relevant memories from the Unison brain, injects
them into the system prompt, then saves a session note after each turn so knowledge
accumulates across conversations.

Auth is a `usk_...` machine key via `UNISON_TOKEN` env var or `token=` constructor
argument. The backend is the security boundary; the client enforces nothing.

## Docs
- [README](README.md): quickstart, environment variables, pipeline usage, deployment
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how an agent installs, authenticates, and uses this client
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md): development workflow, conventions, PR checklist

## Usage
- [backend/unison_pipecat.py](backend/unison_pipecat.py): `UnisonPipecatService` — the Pipecat frame processor
- [backend/server.py](backend/server.py): FastAPI + Pipecat voice server with full pipeline
- [src/app.tsx](src/app.tsx): React frontend — voice UI + live Unison brain memory panel

## Examples
- [README — Pipecat processor](README.md#pipecat-processor): minimal pipeline with `UnisonPipecatService`
- [README — Getting a token](README.md#getting-a-unison_token): provision a `usk_` key in one `curl` call
